name: allowedDomains
label: Allowed sites
help: The sites that can show the embed. Leave it empty to keep the current list, or map `erase` to allow any site.

name: expiresAt
label: Expires at
help: Leave it empty to keep the current date, or map `erase` so that the embed never expires.

name: password
label: Password
help: Bucket explorer embeds only. Leave it empty to keep the current password, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: paused
label: Paused
help: Turn it on to pause the embed, or off to resume it.

name: config
label: Configuration
help: The look and behavior of the embed, as the builder in Nubbo saves it, for example the output of a JSON parser. Settings left out keep the default of the kind, and a partial collection is merged over it.
